annotations.text:
IDEA 1 — One bottom bar instead of six header buttons.
Feed · Snap (big orange shutter) · Ladder · Crew. The camera is always one tap away, which is the whole game.

IDEA 2 — The next quest is pinned everywhere.
Green HUD card on Feed, a chip on Snap, a 'You' row on Ladder, and the unlock modal names the next quest. A judge always knows what to do next.

IDEA 3 — First minute has one job: take Kotaro somewhere.
No feed, no wallet, no tabs. One orange button. The locked chips hint at what comes after the first post.

IDEA 4 — Identity is a badge, not a guess.
Every Axie chip carries Cast (dark) or Owned (green). The human is 'by Guest-7F2A' in the corner, never confused with the Axie.

IDEA 5 — One light 'field' theme on every screen.
The camera keeps translucent white pills over the live picture instead of the current dark chrome, so Snap feels like the same app as Feed.

IDEA 6 — 'Crew' replaces 'Profile' and 'Idol Points'.
What you own is the cast that follows you: a 4-wide grid with level tags on locked faces, props as chips, your moments below. Connect Ronin is a card, not a gate.
